item.title: San Clemente Housing Market Update: October 2026
item.author: roy@roysoldquick.com (Roy Quick)
item.description: San Clemente home prices rose about 4% year over year while inventory tightened, Dana Point jumped 16.6%, and rates sit near 7.3%. Roy Quick breaks down what it means for South OC sellers, landlords and investors.
